newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Police dismiss Stockholm Olympic bombing claim.
newsitem.headline: Police dismiss Stockholm Olympic bombing claim.

text.p: Police on Friday dismissed a claim by an anonymous Swedish group that it had carried out a string of Stockholm fires and a bombing to sabotage the city's bid for the 2004 Olympics.

Stockholm police commissioner Gunno Gunnmo said analysis of a letter sent by the group earlier this week had shown "no evidence to support the suggestion that the person or persons behind the letter should be involved in the incidents."
"(They) have simply taken advantage of incidents that have already occurred," Gunnmo said.

A group calling itself "We Who Built Sweden" said earlier this week in a letter received by the Swedish news agency TT that it was responsible for eight recent fires at sports venues in the Swedish capital and a bomb explosion last week at the stadium built for the 1912 Olympics.
The group threatened to target athletes and the public if Stockholm is awarded the 2004 Olympics.

Police released no details of the analysis to avoid compromising the investigation, but police spokesman Claes Cassel said "the picture of the letter as a whole" had led police to conclude it was a hoax.
Stockholm and four other cities -- Athens, Buenos Aires, Cape Town and Rome -- are bidding for the 2004 Olympics. The decision will be made on September 5.
